note: Both sets struggle somewhat with extracting exact thicknesses from the stacked bar charts, often confusing the top y-axis value with the actual bar thickness. However, Set A is much more accurate overall. Set B contains numerous severe errors, such as claiming a glass_triax thickness of 55 mm (reading the y-axis top instead of the thin layer's thickness) and hallucinating medium_density_foam at the Trailing Edge (TE) for the FFA-W3-211 airfoil.
